transcript: Speaker A: पहली बेटी हुई तो बोला एक और... [When the first daughter was born, they asked for another... after 5 daughters in 5 years, my husband died of a heart attack, leaving me alone. With only 2 lakhs in the bank and 18,000 monthly expenses, I was desperate. My family refused to help. I tried for a call center job but was rejected for lack of basic English. At my daughters' school, I felt humiliated when I couldn't understand the English admission form. Then I tried a 1-rupee trial of the English Seekho app. The expert explained things in Hindi and taught me practical English for banks, schools, and jobs. I practiced with the AI coach at night after putting my kids to sleep. The AI coach corrected me patiently without judging. In two months, I spoke basic English, got the call center job, and later learned reselling on Meesho through the app. Today, I earn 34,000 a month. My daughters are studying, and I have earned respect. When my father apologized, I told him I am self-reliant now. Download the English Seekho app, watch expert videos, and practice with the AI coach for just 1 rupee, 15 minutes a day. You became a mother, now become a lioness, and a lioness must know English.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
